intuition: Validate account numbers and balances before changing either side of a transaction.

brute_force.approach: Search all accounts by their one-based number for every operation.
brute_force.time: transfer O(1), deposit O(1), withdraw O(1)

optimal.approach: Use the account number as a direct list index after checking its valid range.
optimal.time: transfer O(1), deposit O(1), withdraw O(1)

edge_cases: Invalid account numbers leave every balance unchanged.
A withdrawal or transfer exceeding the source balance fails.
